chosen_line.card: All Streams Flow to the Sea

q1_what_did_you_play: I played All Streams Flow to the Sea on Nibbit for 9 damage, then Twin Tides, spending 6 Charge to gain 12 Block and cover the incoming attack.
q2_other_line_considered: I seriously considered Water's Edge followed by All Streams Flow to the Sea for 15 total damage, accepting the full 12 damage.
q3_what_it_gave_up: It gave up 6 immediate damage compared with the two-attack line and spent 6 Charge in exchange for preventing the telegraphed 12 damage.
q4_different_intent: Yes. With no attack or a substantially smaller attack telegraphed, I would have favored Water's Edge plus All Streams Flow to the Sea for more damage.
